planned_lines: At this rate, some enemy fleet
might pick a fight with us sooner
than we expect.
I'll show you how to check what's
nearby, start a battle, and search.
Pick a town or fleet first
if you want to find out more about
it or start a battle.
At sea, you can view details about
nearby towns and fleets.
